title: The 5 Best Baby Bottles for Colic
h1: The 5 Best Baby Bottles for Colic
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for baby bottles for colic, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at baby bottles for colic using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Dr. Brown's Options+ Narrow Glass Baby Bottles, 4-Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: Internal vent system that routes air away from milk, Borosilicate glass construction, BPA-free, Level 1 slow-flow nipple included.
strengths: Vent system is the most studied anti-colic mechanism in the category, with published research behind the original Dr.
Glass construction resists odor and staining better than plastic over years of use
Widest range of nipple flow levels of any brand, useful as the baby grows
Vent parts snap apart and reassemble easily once the routine is familiar
limitations: Most parts per bottle of any major brand, more pieces to wash and track
Vent system needs to be threaded correctly or it leaks at the collar
Glass bottles are heavier and can chip if dropped on tile
features: Internal vent system that routes air away from milk

products.name: Comotomo Baby Bottle, Double Pack, 5oz
products.blurb: Key specs: 100% medical-grade silicone body, Wide neck for brushless hand washing, Dual anti-colic vents in the nipple collar.
strengths: Dual vent design needs no internal straw, fewer parts than Dr. Brown's for a similar anti-colic effect
Silicone body is the softest, most breast-like texture in this list
Wide opening lets most of the bottle be wiped clean by hand without a brush
limitations: Silicone shows fingerprints and grip marks faster than glass or hard plastic
Among the pricier options per bottle in this category
Wide barrel does not fit every bottle warmer or standard cup holder
features: Wide neck for brushless hand washing
Dual anti-colic vents in the nipple collar

products.name: Philips Avent Natural Baby Bottles, Medium Flow, 4-Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: Wide, breast-shaped nipple for latch-matching, AirFree anti-colic valve at the base, 9oz capacity, medium flow nipple.
strengths: 3-piece design is the fastest bottle in this list to wash and reassemble between feeds
AirFree valve reduces swallowed air without a separate internal vent to lose or misthread
limitations: AirFree valve only vents fully when the bottle is held mostly vertical
Plastic can pick up mild odor faster than glass over a year of daily use
Nipple collapse reported occasionally at faster flow levels
features: AirFree anti-colic valve at the base

products.name: Nanobebe Breastmilk and Silicone Baby Bottle Complete Set
products.blurb: Key specs: Breast-shaped bowl design for fast, even warming, Anti-colic vented nipple, 5oz and 9oz bottle sizes included.
strengths: Wide, shallow shape warms breastmilk roughly twice as fast as a standard tall bottle
Complete set includes a pump adapter, cutting a step out of pumping-to-bottle workflows
Compact shape stores flat in a diaper bag pocket better than tall bottles
limitations: Priced as a full set rather than a simple bottle pack, a bigger up-front cost
Wide bowl shape needs a specific bottle warmer insert to heat evenly
features: Breast-shaped bowl design for fast, even warming
Bundled with a pump adapter and pacifiers

products.name: MAM Easy Start Anti-Colic Bottle 9 oz (3-Pack)
limitations: Nipple shape doesn't suit every baby
